# IRCTC API

> High-performance developer platform and REST API gateway for Indian Railways. Access real-time PNR verification, live train GPS tracking, 14-day seat availability calendar forecasts, post-charting vacant berth allocations, real-time ticket fare breakups, and station intelligence.

## Quickstart

### 1. cURL
```bash
curl -s -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  "https://api.irctc.dev/api/v1/pnr/2265248473"
```

### 2. Node.js & TypeScript
```bash
npm install irctc-api
```
```typescript
import { IrctcApi } from 'irctc-api';

const client = new IrctcApi({ apiKey: 'YOUR_API_KEY' });

// 1. Live 14-day seat availability forecast (date: DD-MM-YYYY)
const seats = await client.trains.getAvailability('12557', {
  from: 'NKE',
  to: 'ANVT',
  date: '17-11-2026',
  class: '3A',
  quota: 'GN',
});
console.log(seats.availability[0]);

// 2. Real-time vacant berths after chart preparation (Current Booking)
const vacant = await client.trains.getChartVacant('26501', {
  boardingStation: 'BTH',
  class: 'ALL',
});
console.log(`Vacant Berths: ${vacant.totalVacantBerths}`);

// 3. Live PNR status (10-digit number)
const pnr = await client.pnr.check('2265248473');
console.log(`Train: ${pnr.trainNumber} | Status: ${pnr.chartStatus}`);
```

### 3. Python
```bash
pip install requests
```
```python
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.irctc.dev"
headers = {"x-api-key": "YOUR_API_KEY", "accept": "application/json"}

# Live seat availability (date: DD-MM-YYYY)
res = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/api/v1/trains/12557/availability",
    params={"from": "NKE", "to": "ANVT", "date": "17-11-2026", "class": "3A", "quota": "GN"},
    headers=headers
)
print(res.json())
```

---

## API Gateway Overview

- **Base URL:** `https://api.irctc.dev`
- **Protocol:** HTTPS REST with JSON responses and microsecond execution timestamps (`_time` in ms)
- **Authentication:** Header `x-api-key: YOUR_KEY` or `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY`
- **Welcome Credits:** 10,000 free API credits upon signup at https://irctc.dev/dashboard
- **Date Format Rule:**
  - Route Search (`/api/v1/trains/search`): `YYYY-MM-DD`
  - Seat Availability (`/api/v1/trains/:trainNo/availability`): `DD-MM-YYYY`
  - Station Timetable (`/api/v1/trains/stations/:code/timetable/:date`): `DD-MM-YYYY`

---

## Core Endpoints

### Trains & Booking
- `GET /api/v1/trains/search?from=NDLS&to=PNBE&date=YYYY-MM-DD`: Sub-millisecond direct route search between stations.
- `GET /api/v1/trains/search/name?name=shatabdi`: Instant prefix search for trains matching partial or full name.
- `GET /api/v1/trains/:trainNo`: Full timetable, sequential route halts, distance, and lat/lng coordinates.
- `GET /api/v1/trains/:trainNo/fare?from=ANVT&to=MFP&class=all&quota=GN`: Real-time ticket fare breakup across classes (Base, Superfast, GST, Catering).
- `GET /api/v1/trains/:trainNo/availability?from=NKE&to=ANVT&date=DD-MM-YYYY&class=3A&quota=GN`: Real-time PRS seat & berth availability with 14-day forecast.
- `GET /api/v1/trains/:trainNo/chart-vacant?boardingStation=BTH&class=ALL`: Real-time post-charting vacant berths for Current Booking & TTE allotment.
- `GET /api/v1/trains/cancelled`: Daily fully and partially cancelled trains across Indian Railways with 0ms cache.

### Stations & Timetables
- `GET /api/v1/trains/stations?q=patna`: High-speed prefix-tree station autocomplete for 8,500+ Indian Railways stations.
- `GET /api/v1/trains/stations/:code`: Station metadata, full name, railway zone, and state.
- `GET /api/v1/trains/stations/:code/timetable/:date`: Complete daily scheduled arrivals and departures (`date: DD-MM-YYYY`).

### Live Telemetry & PNR
- `GET /api/v1/live/:trainNo`: Real-time GPS running position, current halt, and delay minutes.
- `GET /api/v1/live/station/:stationCode?hours=2`: Real-time station arrivals & departures board with platform numbers and delay minutes.
- `GET /api/v1/pnr/:pnr`: Live 10-digit PNR passenger manifest, berth/coach allocation, and charting status.

### System & Health
- `GET /health`: Public gateway liveness check returning `{"status":"up","version":"1.0.2"}`.

---

## Railway Constants Cheatsheet

### Travel Classes
- `1A`: First AC
- `2A`: Second AC
- `3A`: Third AC
- `3E`: AC 3-Tier Economy
- `SL`: Sleeper Class
- `CC`: AC Chair Car
- `2S`: Second Sitting (Non-AC)
- `EC`: Executive Chair Car
- `EA`: Anubhuti Executive Class

### Booking Quotas
- `GN`: General Quota (default)
- `TQ`: Tatkal Quota
- `PT`: Premium Tatkal Quota
- `LD`: Ladies Quota
- `SS`: Senior Citizen / Lower Berth Quota
- `HP`: Physically Handicapped Quota

### PNR Passenger Status
- `CNF`: Confirmed (Berth and Coach assigned)
- `RAC`: Reservation Against Cancellation (Guaranteed seat onboard, shared berth)
- `WL`: Waitlist (Not guaranteed travel)
- `RLWL`: Remote Location Waitlist
- `PQWL`: Pooled Quota Waitlist
- `CAN`: Cancelled

### Berth Identifiers
- `LB`: Lower Berth | `MB`: Middle Berth | `UB`: Upper Berth
- `SL`: Side Lower | `SU`: Side Upper | `SM`: Side Middle (3E coaches)
- `WS`: Window Seat (Chair Car)

---

## Standard Error Envelope

When a request encounters an error (HTTP 4xx/5xx), the gateway returns:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Detailed error message",
  "code": "ERROR_CODE",
  "_time": 0.42
}
```

### Standard Error Codes
- `BAD_REQUEST` (400): Missing or malformed parameters.
- `UNAUTHORIZED` (401): Missing or invalid API key.
- `INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS` (402): Account credit balance exhausted. Top up via dashboard.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): Account suspended or permission denied.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): Resource (train, station, or PNR) not found.
- `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (429): Concurrency limit reached.
- `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (503): Upstream railway system under maintenance.

## Documentation & Guides

- [Developer Portal](https://irctc.dev): Developer platform, playground, and account dashboard.
- [API Documentation](https://irctc.dev/docs): Interactive schema definitions and multi-language code snippets.
- [API Playground](https://irctc.dev/playground): In-browser testing sandbox with real-time latency metrics.
- [PNR Status API](https://irctc.dev/pnr-status-api): Real-time Indian Railways PNR passenger manifest, berth/coach allocation, and charting status.
- [IRCTC Seat Availability API](https://irctc.dev/irctc-seats-availability-api): 14-day continuous calendar forecast across travel classes and quotas.
- [Vacant Berths After Charting API](https://irctc.dev/chart-vacant-berths-api): Real-time vacant berths post-charting for Current Booking & TTE allotment.
- [Live Train Running Status API](https://irctc.dev/live-train-status-api): Real-time satellite GPS tracking, current station, and delay minutes.
- [Trains Between Stations API](https://irctc.dev/trains-between-stations-api): Direct route discovery, travel duration, running days, and base fares.
- [Train Fare API](https://irctc.dev/train-fare-api): Real-time ticket fare calculation with itemized fee breakups (Base, Superfast, GST).
- [Train Schedule API](https://irctc.dev/train-schedule-api): Full timetable, sequential station halts, distances, and GPS lat/lng coordinates.
- [Developer Guides Hub](https://irctc.dev/guides): Step-by-step practical implementation guides and bot blueprints.
- [WhatsApp Train Status Bot Guide](https://irctc.dev/guides/whatsapp-train-status-bot-nodejs): Tutorial on building a WhatsApp live train running status & PNR bot with Baileys and Node.js.
- [Telegram Vacant Berths Alert Bot Guide](https://irctc.dev/guides/telegram-vacant-berths-alert-bot): Tutorial on monitoring chart preparation and sending Telegram alerts when vacant berths open for Current Booking.
- [Check PNR Programmatically Guide](https://irctc.dev/guides/check-indian-railway-pnr-programmatically): Comprehensive guide to checking 10-digit Indian Railways PNR status with Node.js and Python.
- [Automated Seat Availability Tracker Guide](https://irctc.dev/guides/irctc-seat-availability-tracker-python): Python daemon to monitor 14-day seat availability and send Telegram/Discord alerts when seats open.
- [NPM SDK Client](https://www.npmjs.com/package/irctc-api): Zero-dependency Node.js and TypeScript client library (`v4.1.0`).
